Add helpers to `AssertionRewriter`:

```python
def _is_builtin_all_any(self, node):
    return (isinstance(node, ast.Call)
            and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
            and node.func.id in ("all", "any")
            and len(node.args) == 1 and not node.keywords
            and not getattr(node, "starargs", None)
            and not getattr(node, "kwargs", None))

def _unroll_all_any_assert(self, assert_):
    # Only direct `assert all(x)` / `assert any(x)`.
    test = assert_.test
    if not self._is_builtin_all_any(test):
        return None
    func_id = test.func.id  # "all" or "any"
    arg = test.args[0]
    # Normalize: `all([elt for t in iter if c])`, `all(elt for ...)`
    # (GeneratorExp/ListComp/SetComp) and plain `all(iterable)`.
    if isinstance(arg, (ast.GeneratorExp, ast.ListComp, ast.SetComp)):
        elt, generators = arg.elt, arg.generators
    else:
        # `assert all(items)` -> `for @py_tmp in items: assert @py_tmp`
        elt, generators = None, None
        iterable = arg
        target = ast.Name("@py_all_any_tmp", ast.Store())
        # built below as generic loop
        return self._make_all_any_loop(
            assert_, func_id, elt, generators,
            plain_iterable=iterable)

    return self._make_all_any_loop(assert_, func_id, elt, generators)

def _make_all_any_loop(self, assert_, func_id, elt, generators, plain_iterable=None):
    # `assert all(elt for t in it [if c])` ->
    #   `for t in it: [if c:] <rewritten assert elt>`
    # which short-circuits on first falsy element and reuses all
    # existing explanations (Compare/Call/Attribute/...).
    # `assert any(elt for t in it [if c])` fails iff every elt is
    # falsy, so on failure any single `assert elt` explains it:
    #   `if not any(<original>): for t in it: [if c:] assert elt`
    # evaluated lazily in one pass via try/except-break-else so
    # generators (possibly infinite) are not materialized and
    # side-effects run once.
    ...
    # Build ast.For nodes nesting generators (handling `is_async`,
    # `ifs`), with body produced by recursively calling
    # `self.visit` on `elt` inside a fresh `ast.Assert`, fixing
    # locations with `set_location`, and returning the statement
    # list to replace the original `assert`.
```
